record.body:
## Description

R1: plan-phase one phase-scoped oracle-author subagent.
R4: execute-phase forbids editing frozen oracle files; amendment path.
R6: verify-work mechanical oracle verify.
R7: skill↔contract consistency green.

## Approach

Owns skills/plan-phase/SKILL.md, skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md, skills/verify-work/SKILL.md (and discuss only if examples must mention freeze). Owns tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py / test_plan_trace.py updates for new examples. Do not edit close_batch or check.py.

1. plan-phase: after thin tdd acceptances exist for deliver/repair, dispatch one oracle-author subagent for the phase with original requirement/spec text only; parent runs aff check; freeze only when assertion-level red; write test_ids, oracle_hashes; derive verify_command from test_ids.
2. execute-phase: briefs forbid editing files listed in oracle_hashes; pushback → create oracle-amendment (status requested); parent approves (status approved) and updates freeze fields.
3. verify-work: oracle-backed requirement verified mechanically when assertion red at base, green at head, hashes match or approved amendment; wire close request to include what close-batch needs.
4. Examples must be legal under the contract (test_ids, oracle_hashes, oracle-amendment create shapes).
5. Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py tests/test_plan_trace.py -q
